_comment: Copy to config/radar.local.json (gitignored) and fill in this machine's values. A list here replaces the committed list in config/radar.json; an object merges into it. Secrets never go here: the Vercel token is the keychain item grip-vercel (or VERCEL_TOKEN), Reddit is grip-reddit as client_id:secret, Bluesky is grip-bluesky as handle:app-password.
